candidates.title: Free Claude Code model-routing toolkit

ease.reason: The README gives setup paths, but connecting coding clients and providers remains technical.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: coding teams might pay for setup help; the README establishes no buyers or demand.

feasibility.reason: A narrow provider-routing demo is possible, but client compatibility and provider access constrain it.

autonomy.reason: The tool can retry with another configured model, while people choose providers and manage accounts.

evidence.reason: The first-party README documents features and setup; it gives no independent use or revenue evidence.

candidates.reason: Readable README describes a real multi-provider coding tool, but not a clearly bounded repeatable service operation or a supported paying customer. Provider availability and terms can change; no customer evidence is supplied.
